dataset: OUTBREAK historical reference — source observations, NOT synthetic people or fitted clinical parameters
manifest_source: outbreak_historical_manifest.json generated from the seven project data sources
source_snapshot: 2026-09-24 project data package; historical records retain their original observation windows

source_notes.WHO_COVID: Weekly reported cases and deaths; not all infections or an infection-fatality probability.
source_notes.OXCGRT: National daily ordinal policy observations; NOT contact reduction or causal effectiveness.
source_notes.WHO_FLUNET: Virological surveillance samples/tests by origin and subtype; do not double count totals and subtypes.
source_notes.WHO_FLUID: ILI/SARI syndromic surveillance, not confirmed cases for a specific virus.
source_notes.WHO_VPD_INCIDENCE: Annual incidence rates with original unit and disease; not per-contact daily probability.
source_notes.WHO_VACCINATION: Coverage by antigen, target population, source category and year; not protection from a hypothetical novel infection.
source_notes.WHO_MERS: Country-level cumulative snapshot, not a time series of weekly cases.

use_in_engine: Descriptive historical context only. No value in this manifest is used to set beta, latentDays, infectiousDays, severeProbabilityByAge, deathProbability*, vaccine protection, bed capacity or intervention efficacy.
excluded_from_git: Large original CSV/XLSX source extracts, 40 MB consolidated historical gzip and ~9 MB aggregate JSON remain in the research package rather than being silently embedded into the GitHub Pages map.
